research_questions.intended_use: Find regressions and independent comparator/oracle evidence.

include: Publicly obtainable implementation that parses Aozora Bunko text or markup, has a documented entry point, and was identified by the repository's bounded ecosystem survey before refreshed results are inspected.
Keep a qualifying candidate even if its pinned revision fails to build or run; the failure is a result.
exclude: Exclude converters that only download, clean, or tokenize already-stripped text and do not parse Aozora markup.
Exclude duplicate forks with no parser-relevant divergence; record the upstream/fork relation instead.
Exclude an implementation from execution only when no reproducible build can be constructed from its pinned public source; retain it in the inventory with that reason.

corpora.selection: Every schema-valid vector present at the pin; no post-result filtering.
corpora.denominator: All selected vectors for construct-level rates, including failure, timeout, unsupported, and silent-drop outcomes.

corpora.selection: Every valid primary text member emitted by the pinned extractor; invalid archive/member selection is reported separately and never removed after parser results are seen.
corpora.denominator: All selected works for work rates; all source bytes or authoritative construct occurrences across those same works for frequency-weighted rates.

robustness.inclusion: All four manifest cases, in manifest order, exactly once per executable included parser and measurement mode; no result-dependent additions, removals, or relabelling.

diagnostics.inclusion: All four prelabelled cases, labels, severities, and UTF-8 byte spans, in manifest order, exactly once per executable included parser and measurement mode.

outcome_rules.failure: Non-zero exit, signal, crash, invalid native artifact, or invalid adapted artifact. Count in every applicable denominator and publish the stage.
outcome_rules.timeout: Wall time greater than 300 seconds per work after process start; terminate the process group, retain partial artifacts, and count as failure and timeout.
outcome_rules.unsupported: Parser explicitly rejects or documents no support for a construct. Count as unsupported and as not covered; do not relabel as missing.
outcome_rules.silent_drop: An authoritative non-whitespace visible source region or construct occurrence is absent from output without a diagnostic covering that region. Count exact regions/bytes and affected works.
outcome_rules.uncertainty: Publish exact counts. For binomial work/vector proportions publish two-sided 95% Wilson intervals; for performance publish median, p95, and 95% bootstrap intervals from 10000 resamples with seed 20260714.
outcome_rules.missing_data: Never impute. Publish missing with reason (not-applicable, unavailable, build-failure, run-failure, timeout, or non-comparable); retain the candidate and denominator. Owned-contract capabilities with no analogue are non-comparable, not competitor zeros.

axes.denominator: All authoritative construct types for type coverage; every authoritative occurrence for weighted coverage.
All authoritative visible bytes and all applicable authoritative occurrences in the fixed corpus.
Every selected work or robustness fixture, with failures retained.

outputs: diagnostic presence, severity, stable code, and relevant-span counts
axes.denominator: Every prelabelled diagnostic fixture; unavailable native fields are missing, not zero.
Every span-bearing authoritative occurrence and every source byte eligible for coverage.
All fixed performance works and repetitions, including timed-out repetitions; warm-up excluded by declaration only.

outputs: open issue and release cadence observations
axes.denominator: One pinned repository observation per candidate; unknown values are missing.
Every inventoried candidate, including build failures.

outputs: declared project and bundled dependency licenses
axes.denominator: Every inventoried candidate; absence or ambiguity is missing/flagged, not a failing quality score.

performance_protocol.environment: x86_64-linux; root flake devShell; RUSTC_WRAPPER=; SCCACHE_DISABLE=1; LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; TZ=UTC; network disabled

analysis.reporting_order: Publish candidate rows in the inventory order and axes in the registered order; separate observations, interpretations, limitations, native results, and adapter-normalized results.

use_case_weighting.procedure: Declare weights before applying them, publish each component, vary every non-zero weight independently from one-half to twice its declared value and include equal-weight and leave-one-axis-out cases; report every ranking/conclusion change.
